The vendor shall ensure polite and cordial behaviour of personnel with the employee’s canteen commi ttee and visitors at the Canteen andany report of improper behaviour shall warrant appropriate action. Food items should be made available for supply from 6.00 AM to 7.0 0 PM on all days. XI. Items should be prepared by using LPG only. Office is having 4 (four)empty cylinders available as a co mmercial customer. XII. The waste should be removed and thrown out of the premises and cleanliness should be maintained. C anteen should be kept clean and tidy. Care should be taken to maintain hygiene. XIII. The quality of the items served should commensurate with the rates quoted by the agencies and if it f ound otherwise, the contract is liable to be cancelled. A demonstration shall be organized by the successful bidder for testing the quality of some of the food items before taking o ver the canteen. XIV. The vendor shall not sub-contract the services to the other agency or individual.

XV. The vendor shall be in touch with the canteen committee for ascertaining the holidays/likely holidays. The vendor shall not be entitled to any compensation for any loss incurred for sudden declaration of a wor ki ng day as a holiday. XVI. Period of contract: Two year period.
